parameters.text:
=Extract the job requirements from the client document below.
Use only information stated in the document. Do not guess.

Formatting rules:
- start_date: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
- work_mode: exactly one of "remote", "hybrid", "onsite". Put details (e.g. office days) in work_mode_details.
- client_budget: the rate or budget stated by the client, with currency and unit. If the client asks for our rate instead, leave it empty.
- job_description: 1–2 sentence summary of the role and responsibilities.

If a field is not stated, use an empty string or an empty array,
and add the field name with a short note to "missing_info".

Document:
{{ $json.document }}

nodes.name: Basic LLM Chain
nodes.notes: Extracts job requirements from the client document into structured JSON. Missing data → missing_info.

nodes.name: Anthropic Chat Model
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 4.5, temperature 0 for consistent extraction, max 1024 tokens.

}
